statement_summary: Written program approved by the board or its committee
ISO designated by the board with a direct line to the Audit and Risk Committee
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk acceptance authority tied to the board's risk appetite
Service provider due diligence, contract terms, annual SOC review, 53.4 contacts
Risk-based independent testing of key controls
Annual report to the board on the program
Validation and fair lending testing of models before production use
Unique accounts in every system; no shared accounts
Workforce MFA; hardware keys for administrators; number matching
Required customer MFA and out-of-band beneficiary confirmation
Same-day access removal at termination, including the core
Quarterly access reviews; ISO review of core super users
Maker-checker; approvers cannot maintain beneficiary templates
Callback to the phone number on file for emailed or phoned wire requests
Out-of-band verification for customer password resets
Report suspected payment fraud within 15 minutes
Notification incident determination and 36-hour OCC and Federal Reserve notice
Regulator and customer notice for sensitive customer information
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (Supp. A II.A.1.b; III.A); Fla. Stat. 501.171

statement_summary: SAR filing and immediate law enforcement notice for ongoing violations
Immediate wire recall and IC3 report for fraudulent payments
Annual incident response tabletop
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit; secure portal for loan files
Certified destruction with serial-number certificates
Isolated, immutable backups tested quarterly
Annual awareness training and quarterly phishing simulations
Role-based BEC and wire-fraud training for branch and wire-room staff
Approved generative AI tools only
